description: Macro research or checkpointed morning changes across supported economic series. Access: USD needs no API key; other currencies return subscription_required with a subscribe link.

checkpoint.description: morning: next_checkpoint from last delivered brief; omit initially for baseline.

currencies.description: morning: 1-10 customer currency codes from data_catalogue, required.

currency.description: Catalogue currency code; optional for spoken. Morning uses currencies instead.

depth.description: brief: currency summary; indicator: trend and catalysts; regime: macro regime; research_pack: indicator context; spoken: news to read aloud; morning: changes since last brief.

end_date.description: History upper bound YYYY-MM-DD; ignored by brief, spoken, morning.

indicator.description: Catalogue slug; required for indicator and research_pack depths.

since.description: morning: last-delivery ISO 8601 with UTC offset; only without checkpoint.

start_date.description: History lower bound YYYY-MM-DD; ignored by brief, spoken, morning.
